claim_status: HEURISTIC COVERAGE ONLY; the 89 LM-selected patterns are not certified geometric obstructions
containment_semantics: non-induced: pattern edges map to target edges; pattern nonedges are unconstrained
timeout_policy: every target-pattern timeout is recorded and counted conservatively as no hit
sampling_design: five equal-size deterministic reservoir strata; aggregate sample fractions and greedy orders are unweighted across deliberately unequal populations

unweighted_stratified_union_coverage.interpretation: descriptive only; not a population estimate

population_weighted_preexisting_deferred.uncertainty_method: population-weighted stratumwise Wilson score intervals; descriptive, not simultaneous

greedy_marginal_coverage_unweighted_stra.interpretation: ranked on equal-size strata; not population weighted
